gbm_population_evidence.quote: Cervical Cancer; Breast Cancer; Colon Cancer; NSCLC; mCRPC (Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer); Glioblastoma; Nonsmall Cell Lung Cancer

Recurrent glioblastoma (only enrolled in MAD Q4W cohorts) with evidence of recurrent disease (RD) demonstrated by disease progression using modified Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology (RANO 2.0) criteria.

candidate_evidence.quote: ²¹²Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 is a radioimmunoconjugate comprised of ²¹²Pb, the metal chelator DOTAM (1,4,7,10-Tetrakis(carbamoylmethyl)-1,4,7,10- tetraazacyclododecane) and a GRPR-targeted antagonist.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Having first or second glioblastoma recurrence, after standard therapy that includes prior radiation therapy (RT) and at least 12 weeks from completion of RT prior to first administration of 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 radioactivity concentration as a function of time in whole blood, plasma and urine

role_evidence.quote: In the dose escalation portion, a classic 3+3 design will be utilized for the SAD cohorts and a Boin design for the MAD cohorts.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational lead-212 (212Pb) alpha-emitting radioligand: DOTAM chelator conjugated to a GRPR-targeted antagonist peptide

role_evidence.quote: Presence of 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 uptake by SPECT/CT scan in the tumor lesion(s).

agents.drug_class_hint: lead-203 (203Pb) SPECT imaging form of the same GRPR ligand, used for patient selection

biomarkers.biomarker_other: GRPR (gastrin-releasing peptide receptor) expression, assessed by 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 SPECT/CT uptake

source_quote.quote: Presence of 203Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 uptake by SPECT/CT scan in the tumor lesion(s).

flag.reason: GRPR expression is target-matched but assessed only by imaging uptake; manual excludes imaging-only markers from molecular biomarkers

coder_notes: Basket trial; glioblastoma named in conditions and inclusion criteria (recurrent GBM in MAD Q4W cohorts). 212Pb-DOTAM-GRPR1 named by ligand without isotope per W1 (no INN in record). The 203Pb diagnostic form is not a registered intervention but is required for eligibility in all participants and has its own safety outcome, so listed as diagnostic_agent. PK is whole blood/plasma/urine only. Title also requires 'GRPR-expressing tumors'.
